questions.definition: A **perfume** is a mixture of scented oils used to give a pleasant smell to the skin or hair.
options: a liquid used to clean dishes
a product applied to the body to smell nice
questions.answer: a product applied to the body to smell nice

questions.definition: The **subway** is an underground railway system used for public transport in many cities.
options: a street where cars drive in one direction
a train that runs below ground level
questions.answer: a train that runs below ground level

questions.definition: If someone is **deliberate**, they are doing something on purpose, often without thinking about the consequences.
options: doing something intentionally to cause harm
questions.answer: doing something intentionally to cause harm

questions.definition: A **caterer** is a person or company that prepares and serves food at events or restaurants.
options: a chef who works in a kitchen at home
a specialist in preparing meals for special occasions
a person who cleans dining areas
questions.answer: a specialist in preparing meals for special occasions

questions.definition: When you **sulk**, you look or behave unhappy and silent, often because you are angry or disappointed.
options: staying quiet and annoyed for a long time
questions.answer: staying quiet and annoyed for a long time
